mapper.select: select a.ID,a.SECOND_LEVEL,a.CONTRACT_NO,a.PROJECT_NAME, a.COUNTERPARTY,a.SECONDPARTY,a.COMPANY_OR_DEPARTMENT,a.`OWNER`, a.BID_DATE,a.SEAL_DATE,a.FILING_DATE,a.CONTRACT_AMOUNT,a.PARTYC,a.SUM_AMOUNT, a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID,b.SN as bizProjectSn,b.NAME as bizProjectName, b.TYPE as bizProjectType,b.INDUSTRY_CLASSIFICATION as industryClassification from BIZ_CRM_HETONG a left join BIZ_PROJECT b on a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = b.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.STATUS = '1'

select a.*, b.SN as bizProjectSn,b.NAME as bizProjectName, b.IS_EPC as isEpc,b.IS_EPCF as isEpcf,b.IS_LEAD as isLead, b.TYPE as bizProjectType,b.INDUSTRY_CLASSIFICATION as industryClassification, b.IS_CONSORTIUM as isConsortium,b.REGION as region,b.LOCATION as bizProjectLocation from BIZ_CRM_HETONG a left join BIZ_PROJECT b on a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, b.SN as bizProjectSn,b.NAME as bizProjectName, b.IS_EPC as isEpc,b.IS_EPCF as isEpcf,b.IS_LEAD as isLead, b.TYPE as bizProjectType,b.INDUSTRY_CLASSIFICATION as industryClassification, b.IS_CONSORTIUM as isConsortium,b.REGION as region,b.LOCATION as bizProjectLocation from BIZ_CRM_HETONG a left join BIZ_PROJECT b on a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = b.ID where a.ID = ${id}

select a.CONTRACT_NO as contractNo, a.PROJECT_NAME as projectName,a.SECOND_LEVEL as secondLevel, a.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as contractAmount,a.COUNTERPARTY as counterparty,a.INVEST_SCALE as investScale, a.COMPANY_OR_DEPARTMENT as companyOrDepartment,a.`OWNER` as owner,a.REGISTER as register, a.SEAL_DATE as sealDate,a.FILING_DATE as filingDate,a.IS_FILING as isFiling,a.HTSTATUS as htstatus, a.ID as id,a.STATUS as status,a.MODEL_ID as modelId,a.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as processInstanceId,a.SUM_AMOUNT as sumAmount, b.IS_EPC as isEpc,b.TYPE as bizProjectType,b.INDUSTRY_CLASSIFICATION as industryClassification, b.IS_CONSORTIUM as isConsortium,b.REGION as region,b.LOCATION as bizProjectLocation from BIZ_CRM_HETONG a left join BIZ_PROJECT b on a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
